name: lorekeeper-identity
note: Framework-neutral source of truth for the Lorekeeper palette and type. brand/tokens/tokens.css and brand/CONTRAST.md are generated from this file by brand/tokens/build.mjs. Edit this file, then regenerate; never edit the generated files by hand.

page.role: The page itself. Warm parchment, not white: a field journal left open in daylight.

surface.role: A card, panel, or sheet lifted off the page.

surface-2.role: A recessed surface: code blocks, table headers, quiet fills.

ink.role: Body text and the mark in its default weight. Blue-black, the colour of iron-gall ink, not the brown-black Pathfinder writes in.

muted.role: Secondary text: captions, metadata, provenance lines.

line.role: Decorative hairline. Never the only signal that something is separate, disabled, or selected.

line-strong.role: A boundary that must be perceivable: input borders, dividers that carry meaning.

accent.role: Deep indigo. The mark, links, focus rings, and filled primary surfaces. Dark enough to be a text colour, so there is no separate link token.

accent-ink.role: Text and icons on a filled accent surface.

gold.role: Old gilt. The second voice: the star in the mark, an emphasis rule, a highlighted term. Never a second link colour.

gold-ink.role: Text and icons on a filled gold surface.

ok.role: A verified or passing state, always paired with a word or an icon.

no.role: A failing or invalid state, always paired with a word or an icon.

page.role: The page after dark. Cool blue-black night, not an inverted parchment.

surface.role: A card, panel, or sheet lifted off the page.

surface-2.role: A recessed surface: code blocks, table headers, quiet fills.

ink.role: Body text. Warm parchment on night: the light variant's page colour returning as its ink, which is the one place the two variants deliberately rhyme.

muted.role: Secondary text: captions, metadata, provenance lines.

line.role: Decorative hairline. Never the only signal that something is separate, disabled, or selected.

line-strong.role: A boundary that must be perceivable: input borders, dividers that carry meaning.

accent.role: Indigo lifted to periwinkle — far enough to pass on night ground, and no further. Links, focus rings, filled primary surfaces.

accent-ink.role: Text and icons on a filled accent surface.

gold.role: Lamplight. On night ground the gilt warms and brightens, and it carries the mark's star where the light variant lets indigo carry it.

gold-ink.role: Text and icons on a filled gold surface.

ok.role: A verified or passing state, always paired with a word or an icon.

no.role: A failing or invalid state, always paired with a word or an icon.

display.value: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Book Antiqua", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
display.role: Headings and pull quotes. An old-style serif already present on the reader's machine — the archival voice.

sans.value: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
sans.role: Body, interface, and labels. The same system stack Pathfinder uses, deliberately.

mono.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
mono.role: Commands, paths, frontmatter, and any literal a reader may retype.
